تغرندون (form IIIq)
# تَغْرَنْدُونَ (taḡrandūna) /taɣ.ran.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِغْرَنْدَى (iḡrandā)
# تُغْرَنْدَوْنَ (tuḡrandawna) /tuɣ.ran.daw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِغْرَنْدَى (iḡrandā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
